name: Simple GSE Search
description: Provides basic integration with Google Custom Search Engine
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 Provides integration with Google's Custom Search Engine .

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 None

 Back to top 

 Features 
 Simple to configure, just enter your Client ID (CX code) and place the search block, and you're done.

Works by using the JavaScript approach provided by Google.

 Back to top 

 Optional to search provided by core 
 It is recommended that you uninstall the search module provided by default by the Drupal Core.

 Back to top 

 Known problems 
 Please use the issue queue to report any issues.

 Back to top 

 Credits 
 Written by Ajit Shinde 

 Back to top 

 Similar projects 
 Google CSE - provides a lot more features and integrates with the non JavaScript API if you have a paid account. If you need something more than a simple search, this module may solve your needs
